scope: Exact H2 native task transitions, current-chain funding/payment observations, M12 local resource/effect journal, and Cell retention/release adapters. Absence statements below apply to these reviewed paths, not to every experimental module in the repository.

native_task_money_paths.authorization: Native authenticated sender becomes task owner; task-instance-v3 identity binds network, parameters, owner, nonce, provider, budget and deadline.
native_task_money_paths.implemented_effect: Debits the owner's native account by the positive budget and creates a reserved task row carrying that remaining amount.

native_task_money_paths.authorization: Task owner only; task status must still be reserved.
native_task_money_paths.implemented_effect: Credits the task's remaining amount back to the owner, zeros remaining and sets cancelled.

native_task_money_paths.authorization: Named provider only; reserved status; height strictly before native task deadline; nonzero output.
native_task_money_paths.implemented_effect: Binds the output and changes status to receipt. It performs no provider credit; ordinary TaskCancel no longer accepts this status.

native_task_money_paths.authorization: Task owner only; receipt status; exact recorded output; height strictly before native task deadline.
native_task_money_paths.implemented_effect: Executes the actual native provider credit from the remaining task escrow, then zeros remaining and sets settled.

native_task_money_paths.authorization: Native mandatory transition; remaining positive and native deadline at or before current height, processed under mandatory_expiry_per_block.
native_task_money_paths.implemented_effect: Credits remaining to the original owner, zeros remaining and sets expired. This also applies to an unsettled receipt; receipt alone does not guarantee provider payment.

observations_and_local_journal.confirmed: Node obtains the active chain anchor and exact monetary row from its verified native state. New Storage/Repair work accepts live native task funding in reserved or receipt status; an existing receipt output must match the claim subject.

Node payment observation reexecutes the specific admitted native transition and checks branch/header context, exact task/source, command transaction, subject, beneficiary and amount. Net account differences or an ACK alone are not payment proof.

record_native_payment observes and records an already executed native payment. reobserve_native_payment checks the same recorded monetary effect against the current native chain without rewriting its historical observation. Neither API issues money or grants execution authority.

M12 is a local resource/effect journal, not a second monetary ledger. Reorganization can invalidate current funding or payment branch membership but does not erase admitted resource costs, pending effect identities or past payment observations. Pending/Done recovery cannot redispatch the old effect.

cell_custody_boundaries.implemented: The Cell adapters bind existing native task funding to local budgets/effects and retained payload readback.
cell_custody_boundaries.not_implemented_by_reviewed_adapter: They do not submit TaskReserve, TaskReceipt or TaskAccept; they do not add a cancellation-resistant native lock or pay the provider. M12 monetary_reservation/committed_units are local holds, not additional native account debits or provider credits.

cell_custody_boundaries.implemented: Storage admission checks retained_bytes and checked manifest_size * (retain_until_height - retain_from_height), with the term ending no later than the budget deadline.
cell_custody_boundaries.not_implemented_by_reviewed_adapter: The byte-block reservation is neither a per-byte-time native price schedule nor proof of future service or a schedule of periodic native payouts.

cell_custody_boundaries.implemented: Exact immutable contracts bind terms and identities. New release roots may share the exact old physical contracts; they cannot silently extend those old terms. A declared successor is checked by freshly reading its actual payload, matching manifest and ensuring coverage beyond the current height before retirement.
cell_custody_boundaries.not_implemented_by_reviewed_adapter: There is no automatic funded renewal or native cancellation/exit settlement workflow. A different store ID alone does not attest independent administration or a distinct failure domain.

cell_custody_boundaries.implemented: Acknowledgement, verify/readback, reconciliation and repair check actual retained bytes and hashes under the supplied bounds.
cell_custody_boundaries.not_implemented_by_reviewed_adapter: These local checks are not a scheduled WAN retrieval challenge protocol, independent replica proof, byte-time service accrual or challenge-conditioned native settlement.

cell_custody_boundaries.implemented: Repair uses a separate current native task/Repair budget and immutable operation/subject, with CPU, download/upload and attempt reservations, actual retained-byte verification and original-effect reconciliation.
cell_custody_boundaries.not_implemented_by_reviewed_adapter: Repair resource charges and completion readback do not themselves pay a repair provider. The local driver does not establish ongoing network replica monitoring or guaranteed repair finance.

cell_custody_boundaries.implemented: New effects reobserve genuine current funding. Original pending/completed effects and local physical history remain bound to their original identities across reorg; native payment currentness must be reobserved separately.
cell_custody_boundaries.not_implemented_by_reviewed_adapter: Local retention cannot prevent the native owner cancelling a still-reserved task or guarantee funding survives a reorganization. It does not define compensation, reorg finality insurance or automatic settlement of future custody obligations.

cell_custody_boundaries.implemented: Root retirement requires an acknowledged, expired, verified duty and settled original repairs. Physical object reclamation is separate and holds the catalog writer while rejecting references from every other live/pending/expired-but-not-retired root; original per-object terms and any required successor still apply. Node retirement reobserves original completed effects against the current native chain.
cell_custody_boundaries.not_implemented_by_reviewed_adapter: Expiry alone does not reclaim bytes. A general historical-version selection/rollback-window policy and CURRENT/FinalUse authorization remain external; these reviewed APIs do not infer them. Local retirement does not rewind after a later reorganization.

change_in_this_candidate.implemented: Single-Cell retention and repair now call the existing read-only check_effects before creating local monetary/resource holds or the first physical reservation. Known inadmissible first work is refused before those reservations, while exact admitted Pending/Done recovery remains available after the service window.
scope_limits: No native task command, monetary rule, signed namespace or stored monetary schema was changed.
This admission fix does not refund an already admitted unknown effect, lock cancellation, initiate provider payment or prove future byte-time custody.

remaining_protocol_and_authorization_wor: Specify immutable custody pricing, term extension, renewal and exit/refund/penalty rules, including their relation to native task deadlines and actual byte-time service.
Specify fresh retrievability challenges, independent failure-domain evidence, repair triggers and repair finance, with bounded proof/admission costs.
Define cancellation and reorganization settlement semantics in the native authority where stronger guarantees require consensus enforcement; a local M12 record cannot provide those guarantees.

Compose actual authorized provider receipt and owner acceptance/payment transactions where the existing native task protocol is sufficient; bind them to exact custody/service evidence and current-chain observations.
Specify retained version roots and rollback windows before GC, without turning transport, local readback or catalog presence into release selection or FinalUse authority.
